_comment: Invented, for the demo page at docs/demo/. No real artist, venue, fee or counterparty appears here, which is the point: the demo can be handed to anyone. The real checklists live in Supabase and are never built into a page.

checklists.title: Diwali Comedy Night (sample)
checklists.subtitle: Sample data for the demo · not a real show

setup.label: Venue
setup.note: room and capacity drive everything else

tasks.task: Agree the fee and what it includes
tasks.why: All-in or plus-expenses is the difference between a margin and a loss
Nothing else is worth spending on until this exists
A nearby date by the same act halves your audience

tasks.task: Hold the room and the date in writing
tasks.why: A verbal hold is not a hold

tasks.task: Confirm the seating layout and sightlines
tasks.why: Rows behind a pillar are seats you cannot sell twice

tasks.task: Book sound, lighting and a backup mic
tasks.why: One dead mic ends a comedy show
Lead times are the constraint, not the paperwork
Late submission risks the permit, not just the schedule

tasks.task: Set price tiers and the on-sale date
tasks.why: The on-sale date sets the whole marketing calendar

tasks.task: Test the checkout end to end
tasks.why: Find the broken flow before the buyers do
Nothing goes on sale without a poster
This audience books through people it already follows
Most tickets sell in the final ten days

tasks.task: Confirm arrival, soundcheck and set times
tasks.why: The one document everybody works from

tasks.task: Brief door staff on the guest list
tasks.why: A queue at the door is the first thing an audience remembers

tasks.task: Reconcile settlement and file the numbers
tasks.why: Next year's pricing comes from this year's actuals
